# netskope_rbac_role (Data Source)

RBACRole DataSource

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netskope_rbac_role" "my_rbacrole" {
  role_id = 1
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `role_id` (Number) Role numeric ID (API-assigned)

### Read-Only

- `api_groups` (Attributes List) API groups assigned to this role with their permissions (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--api_groups))
- `description` (String) Role description
- `ip_allow_list` (Attributes) IP allow list configuration. ipList is normalized to strings by hook (API returns objects with timestamps on GET). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--ip_allow_list))
- `name` (String) Role name (unique per tenant)

<a id="nestedatt--api_groups"></a>
### Nested Schema for `api_groups`

Read-Only:

- `api_group_id` (Number) API group numeric ID
- `permission` (String) Access level for this API group


<a id="nestedatt--ip_allow_list"></a>
### Nested Schema for `ip_allow_list`

Read-Only:

- `enable_ip_allow_list` (Boolean) Whether the IP allow list is enforced for this role
- `ip_list` (List of String) IP addresses allowed for this role. Hook normalizes GET response from objects to strings.
